headline: Promoters of Gem Aromatics file SEBI Takeover Regulation disclosure
sum: Promoters Vipul, Kaksha and Yash Parekh, along with the Parekh Family Trust, filed a disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) regarding substantial acquisition of shares in Gem Aromatics Limited, indicating a change in shareholding structure or control-related event.
detail: The Parekh family entities-comprising individuals Vipul, Kaksha and Yash Parekh and their family trust vehicle-disclosed a change in their aggregate shareholding in Gem Aromatics Limited to the NSE. Under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure of acquisitions of shares that cross prescribed thresholds (typically 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 40%, 50% and 90%). The filing was submitted to the NSE, suggesting either an acquisition by the family group or a restructuring within the promoter block. No consideration amount, exact shareholding percentage, or transaction date is disclosed in the primary document header.
